title: Miro & Dii — Universal Voices
description: Two consistent TTS voice identities — Miro (male) and Dii (female) — that sound the same across every language, built with OpenVoiceOS. Monolingual models per language, including endangered ones like Frisian, Asturian, and Aragonese.

title: ONNX Models
description: Optimized models in ONNX format for fast, cross-platform inference across various applications.
